blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Central and Eastern Visayas can expect cloudy skies with scattered rain showers and thunderstorms on Wednesday, September 16, due to the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ), the state weather bureau said.
